_readme: runs/<BRANCH>/<tier>-<env>/tests/technical/<run>/tech-test-inputs.json - read by scripts/fe_tech_test.py. Every <...> is an OPEN point the skill asks.
environment: <ask - the DEV environment where the test runs>
raw_instrument: <optional - the RAW INSTRUMENT text; default from the instrument (depos: Loan / Depos)>
fe_jobs_run: <optional - the box-fe-jobs-agent run of this instrument, e.g. runs/NY_SCH/tier2-pre/fe-jobs/depos_20261009_1>
raw_market_data_filter: <ask - which BOX_FE.T_BOX_RAW_MARKET_DATA_S rows the test needs (SQL condition)>

bypass.package_export: <ask - BOX_FE.PKG_FE_DEAL_CALCULATION body as deployed in DEV, saved in 01-evidence/ (query in sql/40)>
bypass.fk_portprop: <ask - an FK_PORTPROP that exists in DEV (sql/50 lists some)>
bypass.reference_accounting: <ask - a REFERENCE_ACCOUNTING that exists in DEV>
